main_topics.reason: User opened with daily nausea on Ozempic and the bot and user spent most turns on managing it.
User asked directly whether it is safe to stop for some days and said they almost stopped that day.
User feared the coming dose rise and learned they can ask the doctor to wait.
User described fried food, meat and night-time as worse, and got meal tips over several turns.
User asked when nausea is not normal and needs urgent care, answered in one exchange.
User asked if the drug is working and shared morning readings over two turns.
User planned to raise nausea and dose pacing with the prescriber, but this was a plan rather than a main thread.
User said they were scared about how bad it would be at a higher dose, mentioned once.

output.summary: User started Ozempic three weeks ago and had daily nausea and early fullness, and nearly stopped it. The bot explained the nausea, gave food tips, advised against stopping alone, explained that the dose increase can be delayed, and listed warning signs; no urgent symptoms were present. User said they felt calmer and would keep small meals, check morning sugar, and talk to the doctor before the dose goes up.
